revisions.proposed_text: Reception note: the Albouy critique is engaged by the AJR team (2012 Reply) but rarely carried by the citing mass: Albouy 2012 is co-cited by 50 of 2,695 recent AJR citers (1.9%) and appears in 3.0% of 2013+ citers in the OpenAlex union. The critique's survival in the literature is CONTESTED, not resolved.

revisions.proposed_outcome: UNRESOLVED (CONTESTED IN THE LITERATURE); non-anchoring for field 6
revisions.proposed_text: The rival-channel challenge is now read in full text: Glaeser et al. 2004 (GL-E1, GL-E2) report malaria risk and human capital as rival channels for the settler-mortality instrument; Sachs 2003 (SA-E1) frames the null; the Nobel scientific background (NS-E3) states that the channels are very hard to disentangle. AJR 2001 itself reports that controlling for malaria leaves 0.69 (SE 0.25) vs 0.94 (AJR-E4). The challenge is real, engaged, and unresolved; it does not defeat the field-6 estimate as reported.

revisions.note: Field-6 acquittal stands; citation-network Finding 7 (closure acquittal) is consistent with it.

revisions.proposed_text: Downstream propagation: the AJR team's own Handbook chapter broadens the proxy into 'institutions' and drops the upper-bound qualifier (HB-E1 vs AJR-E2); independent reusers (DML-E1, HW-E1) keep the narrower proxy wording. Failure location: MIXED (PAPER + CITATION), the citation part being self-authored.
